# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then

            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"

Guard semantics: when dispatching the leg workflow (ai-teammate.yml) onto `workflowRef` derived from `{branch}` — actually more generally, when the item carries a `branch` (the PR branch) and the workflow is the leg workflow — probe active runs of that workflow whose `head_branch` equals the item's branch. # Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,

        run: |

          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:

        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

        run: |

            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,

        run: |

            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then

            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js

    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

Now the key design decision. Where to add the branch-keyed guard?

In `triggerWorkflow`, both dispatch paths flow through. The guard should apply to the rework leg workflow (ai-teammate.yml) when the item has a branch. Should it apply to ALL ai-teammate.yml dispatches or just rework? The ticket says "The rework dispatch gate". Applying to all teammate legs dispatched on a branch is strictly safer for push races (dev leg + rework leg on the same branch would also race), but changes behavior beyond the ticket scope. However, being keyed on workflowFile === 'ai-teammate.yml' and item.branch — the dev-on-assignment rule dispatches... let me check whether dev legs use workflowRef={branch}. If a dev leg is in flight on the branch and a rework dispatch fires, they'd race too. But the ticket explicitly says "rework dispatch gate... for BOTH dispatch paths (issue-anchored and PR-anchored)". I'll scope it: apply the guard when the workflow is the leg workflow AND the dispatch is rework-anchored. Hmm, how to know it's a rework dispatch? rule.inputs.leg === 'rework' or the configFile is pr_rework.json. The issue-armed rule has inputs {leg: 'rework'}. The rework-on-label rule has inputs {leg: 'rework'}. Other rules (review) have leg: 'review' — review + rework on same branch also races... but stay scoped to rework per the ticket, or generalize to any leg on the branch?

Actually wait. Let me think about what is the most robust and defensible. The run-title evidence shows the first leg was titled "workflow_dispatch # rework" — no anchor. Hmm, actually let me reconsider: was that really the PR-anchored path? displayTitle "workflow_dispatch # rework" — for PR-anchored, inputs.pr = "1017", issue = ''. The factory's run name "workflow_dispatch #<input> rework"? If issue=' then "# rework". That matches "workflow_dispatch # rework". And the issue-anchored: "workflow_dispatch #100 rework" — issue=100. OK so the factory names runs from the issue input, and PR-anchored dispatches have empty issue → no '#<digits>' token → the gh-944 '#<digits>' whole-token guard can't match → in-flight guard blind. And "· gh-N"/"· pr-N" stub tokens aren't in these titles either since these are factory-side run names, not the SM stub's.

So the existing guards (hasActiveTargetWorkflowRun keyed on title tokens) are blind to PR-anchored factory runs. The branch-keyed probe (head_branch === branch) catches both regardless of title.

Design: add to triggerWorkflow, for the leg workflow when the item carries a branch, after the existing guards:

if (hasActiveLegRunOnBranch(scm, workflowFile, it0.branch)) → suppress
```

But should it be gated on leg === 'rework'? Consider a review leg in flight on the branch and a rework dispatch arriving — they race on the branch (push race). The ticket's push-race rationale applies to any leg pair. But minimal scope is rework. Hmm... Let me check what happens today for review vs rework same-branch: the review rule and rework rules already have title-token guards, so a review leg (titled "· gh-N" etc.) suppresses rework dispatch under the same anchor... partially. I'll keep it general but keyed strictly on the leg workflow + branch: any ACTIVE ai-teammate run on the same branch suppresses a new teammate dispatch on that branch. # Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then

            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js

        run: |

          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',

    {

        run: |

            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
