# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',

    {

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',

    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

```js
// Example: test a module that calls jira_search_by_jql
var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

# Unit Tests for DMTools Agent Scripts

Unit tests for the GraalJS agent scripts in `agents/js/`, runnable via dmtools without any real Jira/GitHub connections.

## Running tests

```bash
# All tests
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_all.json

# configLoader only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_configLoader.json

# smAgent only
dmtools run agents/js/unit-tests/run_smAgent.json
```

## Structure

```
unit-tests/
├── testRunner.js            # Test framework (loaded by JSRunner)
├── test_configLoader.js     # Tests for configLoader.js (35 tests)
├── test_smAgent.js          # Tests for smAgent.js (23 tests)
├── run_all.json             # JSRunner config — runs all test files
├── run_configLoader.json    # JSRunner config — runs configLoader tests only
└── run_smAgent.json         # JSRunner config — runs smAgent tests only
```

## Test framework API

Test files have access to these globals provided by `testRunner.js`:

| Global | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `test(name, fn)` | Register a test case — `fn` throws on failure |
| `suite(name, fn)` | Group tests under a named section |
| `assert.equal(a, b, msg?)` | Strict equality (`===`) |
| `assert.deepEqual(a, b, msg?)` | JSON-serialized deep equality |
| `assert.ok(val, msg?)` | Truthy check |
| `assert.notOk(val, msg?)` | Falsy check |
| `assert.contains(str, sub, msg?)` | Substring check |
| `assert.notContains(str, sub, msg?)` | Negative substring check |
| `assert.throws(fn, msg?)` | Expects function to throw |
| `loadModule(path, requireFn?, mocks?)` | Load a JS module with optional mock injection |
| `makeRequire(moduleMap)` | Build a `require()` shim from a `{ id: exports }` map |
| `configModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/config.js` exports |
| `configLoaderModule` | Pre-loaded `agents/js/configLoader.js` exports |

## Mock injection

`loadModule(path, requireFn, mocks)` shadows global dmtools functions within the loaded module's scope. Mocked globals never affect the real environment.

var capturedJqls = [];

var myMod = loadModule('agents/js/myScript.js',
    makeRequire({ './configLoader.js': configLoaderModule }),
    {

node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

Now I have everything I need. Time to plan the implementation:

## Plan (TDD)

### RED: tests first

**Test file 1: `js/unit-tests/test_branchLegGuard.js`** — pure module tests:
- suite 'branchLegGuard — matching':
 - active leg run on the same branch (different head sha) → true (AC: head move does not bypass)
 - active run on different branch → false
 - completed run on same branch → false
 - active run of a different workflow (path) on same branch → false
 - missing/null inputs → false
 - run missing head_branch → false
 - stale queued run (aged out) → false
 - 2+ runs in list, second matches → true (multi-item case)
- suite for hasActiveLegRunOnBranch with statuses.

**Test file 2: extend `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js`** — engine wiring tests (gh-1028 scenario):
- Test A (AC1): one tick, two rework rules — issue-armed (gh-100 with prNumber/branch) and PR-armed (pr-1017 with same branch) — an in-flight leg run on the branch (opts.workflowRuns.in_progress with head_branch = branch, different head sha, path ai-teammate.yml) → exactly one dispatch... 

Hmm wait. In a single tick with both rules matching: rule 1 dispatches (no active run at probe time... but the workflowRuns mock is static). Sequence within tick: rule 20 (rework-on-red-ci) matches issue gh-100 → triggerWorkflow → probes → mock returns active run on branch → suppressed?! That would suppress BOTH. To model "exactly one leg", the mock needs to reflect dispatch: after the first trigger, a run appears. Use onTrigger to append a run to the workflowRuns list — the mock's listWorkflowRuns returns `byStatus[status]` live object (opts.workflowRuns captured by reference; `byStatus = opts.workflowRuns || {}` and returns `JSON.stringify({workflow_runs: byStatus[status] || []})` — evaluated per call, so mutating opts.workflowRuns.in_progress in onTrigger affects subsequent calls. 

So Test A: onTrigger pushes {status:'in_progress', path:'.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml', head_branch:'ai/gh-100', head_sha: '94988905...'} into workflowRuns.in_progress. Both rules in one tick: first dispatch fires, second rule's dispatch probe sees the run → suppressed. Assert capturedTriggers.length === 1. 

But rule order matters: both rules dispatch through triggerWorkflow. Also each dispatch path's title-token guard must NOT suppress (run has no display_title/name tokens). Also the gh-715 cross-anchor guard probes alt key — runs have no matching titles, fine.

- Test B (AC2 / head move): single rework rule, workflowRuns contains an active run on the same branch but with a DIFFERENT head_sha than the item's head (the moved head) → dispatch suppressed. This directly encodes "a head move between dispatches does not bypass the in-flight probe".
- Test C: a completed leg run on the branch (status completed) → dispatch proceeds (only ACTIVE runs suppress).
- Test D: active run on a DIFFERENT branch → dispatch proceeds.
- Test E: active run of a different workflow path → proceeds.
- Test F: workflowRef 'main' (no {branch}) → guard skipped, dispatch proceeds even with active run on branch.

For the item shape I need github-source items with branch + prNumber. Let me model on the gh-922 tests: `opts.github.items` with the real github source? The gh-922 test used `github: { prList: ..., realSource: true }`. That's heavier. node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

### What changed
Added a branch-keyed in-flight leg guard (gh-1028): `js/common/branchLegGuard.js` (pure probe — an ACTIVE `ai-teammate.yml` run whose `head_branch` IS the dispatch branch, regardless of `head_sha`, owns the branch) wired into `smAgent.triggerWorkflow`, so BOTH rework dispatch arms (issue-anchored `rework-on-red-ci` and PR-anchored `rework-on-label`) suppress a second leg while one is in flight on the PR branch.

**gh-1028 fix — branch-keyed in-flight leg guard.** The live duplicate (PR #1017, 2026-10-18 08:04–08:09Z) happened because two independent guards both had holes: the gh-806 latch keys `(pr, head)` and the first leg's push moved the head, minting a new key; and the PR-armed factory run is titled `workflow_dispatch # rework` — no `· gh-N`/`#N` anchor token, so the gh-715/gh-944 title guards were blind from the issue-armed path.

**Implementation (TDD: RED → GREEN):**
- **`js/common/branchLegGuard.js`** (new, pure): an ACTIVE `ai-teammate.yml` run whose `head_branch` IS the dispatch branch — regardless of `head_sha` — owns the branch. Stale non-running zombies (>6h) age out, `in_progress` never does, no-clock callers fail closed.
- **`js/smAgent.js`**: hoisted require (gh-823-safe) + `hasActiveLegRunOnBranch` probe (4-status fan-out, fail-open) + guard in `triggerWorkflow` covering **both** rework arms (`rework-on-red-ci`, `rework-on-label`), applied whenever the dispatch lands on the branch (`workflowRef={branch}`). Suppression deliberately does **not** consume the `agent:rework` label — dead-letter recovery re-fires a silently dead arm next quiet tick.
- **Tests**: `test_branchLegGuard.js` (14 pure cases) + 6 engine cases in `test_smAgent.js` reproducing the exact live shape (in-flight run on the moved-from head, anchorless title). Both arms in one tick → exactly 1 dispatch (AC1); head move between dispatches → still suppressed (AC2).
- Full suite green on both harnesses: **3873 passed, 0 failed**; committed as `72e7120` on `ai/gh-1028` (completion guard: `git log origin/main..HEAD` non-empty); `outputs/response.md` written.
